commands.description: Create a Zitadel project and scaffold local auth. An interactive setup ends with a note about the Zitadel agent skills, shown once per machine; set NO_SKILLS_PROMPT=1 to hide it.

flags.name: force
flags.description: Overwrite managed files that already exist, and scaffold into a non-empty directory.

flags.name: framework
flags.description: Framework to target.

flags.name: renderer
flags.description: Renderer (default: react). Not yet available: web-component.

flags.name: dev-port
flags.description: Dev-server port; also the issuer origin registered with Zitadel. Defaults to the detected port. Use distinct ports to run several scaffolded apps side by side. In an app already set up, moves it to this port: the dev script, ZITADEL_ISSUER and the allowed origin.

flags.name: skip-install
flags.description: Do not install dependencies after setup updates package.json.

flags.name: preset
flags.description: Sign-in preset for the scaffolded schema and login flow (default: password-first).

flags.name: use-case
flags.description: Use case for the scaffolded schema fields: who signs in to the app (default: minimal).

flags.name: password-min-length
flags.description: Minimum password length for the project's password policy, for example 12; 0 sets none. Without it, setup sets 15, the NIST minimum for password-only sign-in; change it in .zitadel/policies/ later.

flags.name: sso
flags.description: Social sign-in provider to enable while scaffolding, e.g. google. Skips the wizard's provider question; needs --sso-client-id, and the OAuth application must already be registered with the provider. Pipe the client secret in on stdin; never pass it as a flag.

flags.name: sso-client-id
flags.description: Client id of the OAuth application registered with the --sso provider.

flags.name: sso-slug
flags.description: With --sso custom: the name of the connection. Schemas and flows refer to it.

flags.name: sso-display-name
flags.description: With --sso custom: the name shown on the sign-in button.

flags.name: sso-issuer
flags.description: With --sso custom: the provider's issuer URL. Its endpoints come from OIDC discovery.

flags.name: sso-scopes
flags.description: With --sso custom: the scopes to request, separated by spaces or commas. Must include openid. Default: openid profile email.
